item.title: Students discover decapitated bodies in burial pit beneath country park in grisly chance find
item.description: A group of students from Cambridge University have made a grim discovery after stumbling upon an ancient burial pit containing the remains of 10 people. The grisly find was made during a training dig at Wandlebury Country Park near Cambridge. The burial site is located in the middle of an area where Vikings and Saxons frequently battled over territory during the ninth century. The number of bodies buried was identified due to the presence of the skulls, with one showing signs of a decapitation.
